response.sql: WITH account_flows AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS net_flow, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, net_flow, transaction_count, 1.0 * net_flow / SUM(net_flow) OVER () AS net_flow_share FROM account_flows ORDER BY net_flow_share DESC LIMIT 10
